articles.title: Late fee courtesy waiver policy
articles.summary: One courtesy late-fee waiver per 12 months when the account is current; specialist approval required for card fees; log disposition FEE_WAIVED.

articles.title: Foreign transaction fees
articles.summary: FX fees are disclosed and not normally waived; offer the no-FX-fee card if the customer travels often.

articles.title: Unrecognized charge triage
articles.summary: Check merchant descriptor lookup first (many 'unknown' charges are subscriptions); if still unrecognized, lock card, open dispute, issue replacement.

articles.title: Merchant descriptor QXT*
articles.summary: QXT* descriptors belong to a digital-services billing aggregator; ask about streaming or app subscriptions.

articles.title: Premium Travel Rewards Card: pre-qualified offer script
articles.summary: Confirm pre-qualification, explain annual fee and travel credits, soft-pull disclosure.

articles.title: Card payments and AutoPay
articles.summary: Payments before 8pm ET post same day; offer AutoPay for the minimum or full balance.
